## Philosophy quotes about beauty

Beauty raises questions about judgment, form, pleasure, and whether aesthetic value is subjective or shares standards.

14 passages · 8+ thinkers in this selection

### Why this theme matters

Aesthetics asks what beauty is, how taste is educated, and how art discloses truth or shapes moral perception.

### In the history of philosophy

Plato, Kant, Schiller, and Chinese aesthetic traditions offer distinct routes from beauty to ethics and metaphysics.

### Thinkers in this collection

[Augustine of Hippo](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/augustine-of-hippo) , [Blaise Pascal](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/blaise-pascal) , [Plotinus](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/plotinus) , [Plato](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/plato) , [Immanuel Kant](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/immanuel-kant) , [Xunzi](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/xunzi) , [Friedrich Schiller](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/friedrich-schiller) , [Alexis de Tocqueville](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/alexis-de-tocqueville)

### Frequently asked questions

#### What is beauty according to philosophy?

Answers range from harmony and form to disinterested pleasure or culturally trained perception.

#### Is beauty subjective?

Many theories allow both personal response and intersubjective standards of criticism.
